fusions.name: Hot Iron
fusions.desc: Presses the heated rod to a target for a weapon strike that deals 7 damage, sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and brands it [Marked] for 8 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Beacon Flare
fusions.desc: Fires a flare that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of the flare's damage.

fusions.name: Torchbearers
fusions.desc: Increases your fire damage by 25% for 12 seconds. A torchbearer escort fights beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ember Regalia
fusions.desc: Conjures a rod that increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
